welcome: 👋 Hello, {name}! 🕶 Welcome to Mafia Litsey Bot! Host the ultimate Mafia game in your Telegram groups with smooth inline buttons, night auto-muting, tournaments, store, and exciting roles. 🎮 To start playing: Add me to your group and type /game! 💡 Full command list: /help
help: 📖 Mafia Litsey — Command List: Group Commands: • /game or /oyun — Open new game room • /start — Start game early (with enough players) • /stop — Cancel active game • /setlang — Change group language Private Commands: • /profile — Stats & balance • /shop — In-game store (Role cards, titles, passes) • /daily — Free daily coin bonus • /top — Leaderboard • /clan — Mafia Family (Clan) management • /tournament — Tournaments & prize cups • /lang — Switch language
choose_lang: 🌐 Please select your language / Dil seçin / Tilni tanlang:

role_desc.citizen: You are a peaceful citizen! Vote during daytime trials to purge the Mafia from the city.
role_desc.doctor: Heal one player each night to protect them from death. You cannot heal the same player twice in a row.
role_desc.detective: Inspect a suspect's alignment (Innocent or Mafia) or eliminate a criminal during the night.
role_desc.sergeant: You are the Detective's apprentice! If the Detective dies, you take the badge and become the new Detective.
role_desc.sniper: The secret town marksman! You have 1 night bullet. If you shoot an innocent citizen, you die of guilt the next morning.
role_desc.mafia: Coordinate with fellow mafiosi to eliminate citizens each night.
role_desc.don: You are the Mafia Boss! Check for the Detective and command the nightly assassination.
role_desc.maniac: Solo serial killer! Kill any player each night. Win if you are the last survivor standing.
role_desc.mistress: Block the chosen player's special ability each night.
role_desc.jester: Your sole goal is to fool the town into lynching you at the daytime trial! If lynched, you win the game alone!
role_desc.bodyguard: Protect a target player at the risk of your own life. You will absorb any incoming attack.
role_desc.kamikaze: If lynched during daytime trial, you detonate and take one of your executioners with you.
role_desc.lawyer: Conceal a chosen Mafia member from police inspection during the night.
